options.description:
NB: Under Article 5(1)(c) of the GDPR (data minimization principle), personal data processing must be proportionate and limited to what is strictly necessary for your stated purpose. Only adequate, relevant, and necessary data may be accessed via the e-service.

Therefore:
(i) you may select "clear" or "pseudonymized" data only if aggregated or anonymous data are insufficient for the purposes stated in point 1;
(ii) you may select "clear" data only if pseudonymized data are also insufficient.

elements.label: Does this E-Service allow data downloads?

options.description:
NB: Downloaded data may not be up to date, which conflicts with the data accuracy principle under Article 5(1)(d) of the GDPR. Please limit downloads to cases where they are strictly necessary and justified by the processing purpose.

Also note that under Article 5(1)(b) and (e) of the GDPR (purpose limitation and storage limitation), data may only be kept for the time strictly necessary to achieve the specific, explicit, and legitimate purposes for which they were collected.
